localBiteReport: The most current available reports for Choctawhatchee Bay are from late September to early October 2026 — approximately two to three weeks old rather than this week. According to a Captain Nick report out of Santa Rosa Beach posted on captainexperiences.com, redfish are being caught on slot-sized fish around docks and drop-offs in the bay, and speckled trout are still showing up as well; the same guide noted that sheepshead are expected to pick up in the Choctawhatchee in the coming weeks. A separate guide report on the same page noted that redfish and trout activity in the bayou areas has been heating up as the Destin Fishing Rodeo gets underway in October. Water temperature at this location is currently 81°F. Half Hitch's most recent Destin report (dated 9-28-26, about 2.5 weeks ago) is confirmed posted but its full inshore bay content was not accessible in search results.
